note: Hypothesis, not a fact. Weights follow the 2026-11-21 review of six large Instagram accounts (see docs/RISET-ENGAGEMENT.md); adjust from real insight data once the account has followers.

criteria.question: Does it touch something most Indonesians know or do every day (body, food, sleep, pets, weather, phone, money, traffic, kids' questions)? A topic only specialists care about (rock provenance, chemistry of a lab flame, obscure fossils) scores 0 here and must be skipped unless a plain everyday comparison carries it.
Would most people say 'masa sih?' (disbelief) on hearing it?
Can a 15-year-old understand the hook with NO googling? Can it be told in 1 hook sentence plus 3 short slides?
Would someone send it to a friend?
Is there a primary source with clear numbers?
Is there a strong image, chart or comparison for it?
Is it new to this account?

Is it connected to something people in Indonesia are talking about right now (a news story, a season, a viral topic) or to a number/price/job/school/health topic they feel in daily life? Topical posts beat evergreen ones on other accounts.

Can a stranger who knows NOTHING about the subject understand slide 1 and slide 2 without googling? If the named thing (a spacecraft, a species, a place) needs a long introduction first, it scores low unless one plain sentence is enough.
